answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade: one identity, one bond. A newcomer with no history starts dim, like a distant comet, and earns trust only through verified work over time. A prism of independent attestors - peers, oracles, and auditors - must each confirm the same record before the stake unlocks rewards, so a Sybil farmer would need to fund and age hundreds of bonded identities at once, turning cheap fake accounts into an expensive, slow, easily spotted operation.
